method.evidence: exploratory synthetic communication simulation, not hardware measurements
method.pairing: each seed shares rank pairs, injection times and packet size across both candidates and failure scenarios
method.spread: median and minimum/maximum across seeds; not confidence intervals or a guarantee over traffic distributions
method.ratio: sphere p99 / torus p99 calculated within each seed, then summarized; values above 1 mean higher sphere latency
method.bandwidth: equal_total matches baseline sum of directed capacities; per_link matches each link rate, leaving sphere more total links and bandwidth
method.failure: one seeded undirected link removed before traffic; no live detection, retry or failover tested
method.stencil_bias: fixed logical periodic grid directly matches torus adjacency; sphere placement is not optimized
method.mapping: rank IDs map directly to node IDs; results depend on placement, especially hotspot location
method.physical: sphere surface arcs and configured torus link lengths differ; wire-length, power, package and pin costs are not equalized
method.scope: only the existing flat sphere and torus models; proposed hierarchical/co-located-memory design is not implemented or tested
method.omissions: no compute, HBM transactions, finite buffers, VC credits, protocol overhead, full-system power, or end-to-end application SLO
